title: Observability stack
subtitle: Signals flow from workloads through collectors into one correlated view.

tiles.label: Kubernetes
tiles.says: Pods emit metrics, logs and traces
tiles.detail: Application and platform pods are the source of every signal; sidecars and node agents expose them.

tiles.label: NGINX
tiles.says: Access and error logs at the edge
tiles.detail: The ingress tier writes structured access logs and exposes status metrics.

tiles.label: PostgreSQL
tiles.detail: Exporters surface connections, locks and replication lag.

tiles.label: OpenTelemetry
tiles.detail: Collectors receive OTLP, batch, enrich and forward traces, metrics and logs.

tiles.label: Prometheus
tiles.detail: Pull-based scraping with service discovery; rules turn raw series into alerts.

tiles.label: Log shipper
tiles.detail: A node-level agent tails log files and forwards lines with Kubernetes metadata.

tiles.label: Traces
tiles.detail: Trace IDs link spans so latency can be pinned to a single hop.

tiles.label: Logs
tiles.says: Search by labels, jump from a trace
tiles.detail: Labelled log streams are queried alongside traces using the shared trace ID.

tiles.label: Grafana
tiles.says: Dashboards and alerts in one place
tiles.detail: Panels from metrics, logs and traces share time ranges and variables for fast root-cause.
